name: Fincen

subjectOf.text: Under FinCEN guidance a mere user of virtual currency is not a money services business and faces no registration duty, while a user deemed an administrator or exchanger must comply with reporting and recordkeeping regulations.
subjectOf.abstract: While a user of a virtual currency is not a MSB and not subject to any registration requirements, a user of virtual currencies who is deemed to be an administrator or exchanger will be required to comply with its reporting and recordkeeping regulations.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033
scope_conditions: under FinCEN guidance issued in March 2013 extending the Bank Secrecy Act to virtual currencies

subjectOf.text: Because LER vouchers are closed-loop and non-convertible, they reduce the risk of triggering FinCEN money services business registration and Bank Secrecy Act obligations that attach to convertible or transmissible digital value.
subjectOf.abstract: While convertible or transmissible digital value can trigger FinCEN MSB registration and BSA obligations, LER as closed-loop, non-convertible voucher rewards reduce that risk.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5454054
